report.label: Costs report: longest period and day rows
report.help: The longest period one costs report on Money → Cost ledger → Costs report covers, in days (31–3,660), and the most days it lists one by one (7–1,000); a longer period is shown month by month.

allocation.label: Per-order profit: ad spend share
allocation.help: Whether each delivered order's profit carries a share of the ad spend, spread evenly over the orders delivered in the same month (or day). Always shown as an estimate; nothing is charged or changed.

system.label: VAT system
system.help: Off as shipped. When on, the shop shows the VAT already inside its prices (prices include VAT, so no price changes) at the rates on Money → VAT. "On the delivery charge too" adds the delivery charge to what carries VAT; your accountant decides.

rates.label: VAT rates
rates.help: Your own rates, empty as shipped: a default rate, a rate per category (a sub-category without one takes its parent's) and a rate per product. A product's own rate wins over its category's, a category's over the default. 0 % is a real rate.

report.label: Money report to the owner
report.help: Off as shipped. When on, the Profit & loss figures of the day (or the last 7 days, or the last month) go to the owner by Telegram at the time set, in the language set. Weekly: on the weekday chosen; monthly: on the day of the month chosen (1–28), for the month before. A report missed at its time (the server was down) still goes later the same day, once.

badges.label: Team performance badges
badges.help: Off as shipped. When on, Reports → Team shows what each person did in the week or month (orders confirmed, packed, handed to the courier, support replies), counted from the shop's own records, with a badge for the most in each and for reaching your own minimum (none set as shipped). Recognition only: nothing is paid or taken away.
